extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and maintenance notes for a specific Wikipedia biography article, focusing on sourcing, metadata, and reliability. Intended to signal what needs to be improved for article quality and verifiability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reliance on primary sources
rubrics_metrics.description: This article relies excessively on references to primary sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please improve this article by adding secondary or tertiary sources. Find sources: 'The Sultan of Llang-Llang' – news · newspapers · books · scholar · JSTOR (May 2026). (Includes the banner instruction: 'Learn how and when to remove this message'.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles lacking reliable references
rubrics_metrics.description: Article is categorized as 'Articles lacking reliable references' (flagged from May 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add reliable, verifiable sources (preferably secondary/tertiary) to support assertions and replace or supplement primary-source material; ensure citations come from reputable newspapers, books, academic journals, or other reliable outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide short description / Wikidata description
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden category: 'Short description with empty Wikidata description' (the article's short description is present but Wikidata lacks a corresponding description).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill or synchronize the short description in Wikidata to match the article's short description metadata to improve discoverability and metadata completeness.
